result.scope_note: Research question: Were sport disciplines at the 2026 Winter Games in Italy fully gender balanced? This requires checking official IOC/ sporting records for participation counts, gender splits per sport, and whether any sport had notable gender disparity.

explanation.text: Evidence from Wikipedia and Good Good Good shows most sport disciplines at the 2026 Winter Games in Italy were not fully gender balanced. Wikipedia reports 196 competitors (103 men, 93 women) across 16 sports, with sport-by-sport breakdown showing unequal gender representation. Good Good Good states

women comprise 47% of all athletes, 50 women's events, and 12 of 16 sports achieving full gender parity. The claim 'fully gender balanced' is not corroborated; 47% overall participation and parity in 12/16 sports does not equal 'most disciplines fully gender balanced'.
